intent: Bring brother_printer/cups_queue.py under the 250-line cap by moving the queue-status display and the interactive fix prompt into their own module, with no behaviour change.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: Moved display_cups_queue_status, _offer_queue_fix, the five _dwj_* choice handlers, the _DWJ_ACTIONS table and the four _handle_* dispatchers verbatim into python_pkg/brother_printer/_queue_fix.py.

The _cups_* action primitives stay in cups_queue.py on purpose and _queue_fix imports the three it needs. test_cups_queue.py patches subprocess and time on cups_queue, and those primitives are their only consumers, so moving them would have left subprocess.run unpatched and able to restart the real CUPS service during the suite.
cups_queue.py dropped the imports that only the moved code used (BOLD, CYAN, GREEN, YELLOW, _prompt and the whole TYPE_CHECKING/Callable block); 424 -> 245 lines.

display.py now imports display_cups_queue_status from _queue_fix and get_cups_queue_status from cups_queue, keeping the dependency direction cups_queue <- _queue_fix <- display with no re-export shim and no cycle.

test_cups_queue_part2.py and test_cups_queue_part3.py had their MOD constant and import module repointed at _queue_fix. test_cups_queue.py needed no change at all, which is the signal the seam matched the existing test boundary.

verification.evidence: 402 passed before the split and 402 passed after it - identical pass count, not merely a green run.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from python_pkg.brother_printer import _queue_fix as q, cups_queue as c, display as d; q._cups_enable_printer; q._cups_restart_service; q._prompt; q._handle_disabled_with_jobs; c.subprocess; c.time; c.shutil; c.Path; d.display_cups_queue_status"
verification.evidence: runtime probe OK - every name the three test modules patch is still a real attribute of the module they name, so ruff's TC001 rewrite trap did not fire.
245 and 203 lines, both under the 250-line cap.
ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and pytest-with-coverage all pass on the touched files.

risks: mock.patch pins names to a module. The dangerous direction here was silent rather than red: an unpatched _cups_restart_service would have run systemctl restart cups for real. Mitigated by leaving all four _cups_* primitives in cups_queue.py, which the runtime probe and the unchanged test_cups_queue.py both confirm.
display.py imports from both modules now; a future move of get_cups_queue_status into _queue_fix would create a cycle.
rollback: git revert the commit; cups_queue.py returns to 424 lines and _queue_fix.py disappears.
After rollback, re-run the package suite and confirm it still reports 402 passed.
